subject.title: refactor(state): move device identity into canonical SQLite state

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed one-way SQLite-only device-identity cutover, requiring `openclaw doctor --fix` for retired JSON identities and treating JSON-only downgrade or mixed-version sharing as unsupported?
rationale: This is a deliberate compatibility and recovery contract for persisted cryptographic identity, not a mechanical defect that review automation can choose on maintainers’ behalf.

options.title: Approve the SQLite-only cutover
options.body: Accept the Doctor-owned migration and unsupported JSON-only downgrade contract, then merge after the prerequisite and final exact-head gates pass.

options.title: Preserve upgrade compatibility longer
options.body: Require a maintainer-defined transition or recovery contract before replacing the retired identity store as the only runtime source of truth.

options.title: Defer the migration
options.body: Pause this branch until ownership agrees on downgrade, mixed-version, and recovery expectations for shared state directories.

recommendation.title: Approve the SQLite-only cutover
recommendation.body: Accept the Doctor-owned migration and unsupported JSON-only downgrade contract, then merge after the prerequisite and final exact-head gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies steipete as the current implementation and stack owner best positioned to clarify the proposed migration contract for maintainer approval.
